title: Tomo Tag Handler Group Result
description: A composed group from the tag-handler-interpreter skill (skill→reducer interface). One group = all handled[] items sharing the same (handler, target_path) pair, composed into a single block. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/024-tag-handler-framework/ SDD §5 + README decisions.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel. Always '1' for this revision.

handler.description: ID of the tag-handler that claimed all items in this group.

target_path.description: Resolved vault-relative path of the target note, or null when the target map had no entry for the captured vars. A null group is surfaced (not silently dropped) — consumers must guard.

marker.description: Anchor string in the target note (mirrors tag-handler config, e.g. '## Captures').

composed_block.description: The merged content block for this group — either the output of one LLM compose call (directive path) or the mechanical join of field values (template path).

source_paths.description: Vault-relative paths of all inbox items in this group (for traceability / suggestion rendering).

placement.description: Insertion position relative to the anchor. Mirrors tag-handler config.

compose_mode.description: How the composed_block was produced: 'llm_directive' = one LLM merge call; 'field_template' = deterministic field join (no LLM).

output_format.description: Structure-aware rendering spec carried through from the tag-handler config. Present only when the handler config included output_format. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/025-structure-aware-tag-handler-compose/.

structure.description: Output block shape: table_row = one Markdown table row per item; list_item = one bullet per item.

order.description: Insertion order relative to existing rows/items under the anchor.

granularity.description: per_item = one row/bullet per inbox item; merged = LLM-merged single block.

cells.description: Ordered cell definitions carried from handler config.

field.description: Frontmatter field name to project verbatim into this cell.

synthesize.description: LLM directive for synthesizing this cell's content from the batch.

join.description: Separator between cells for list_item structure. Ignored for table_row.

resolved_anchor.description: Structural anchor resolved by the interpreter for structured insertion. Present only for structured (output_format) groups. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/025-structure-aware-tag-handler-compose/ SDD Data Models.

type.description: Anchor type: heading = matched heading (table header or section); block = matched N-line block (e.g. table header+separator rows).

value.description: The matched anchor content (heading text or \n-joined block lines).

placement.description: Where to insert relative to the resolved anchor: inside = beneath the heading / before next same-level heading; after = immediately after the matched block's last line.

fallback.description: Present when structured rendering was requested but could not be performed. The group falls back to prose-block behaviour. Spec: docs/XDD/specs/025-structure-aware-tag-handler-compose/.

reason.description: Why structured rendering was skipped: cell_count_mismatch = cells != table columns; no_structure_under_marker = heading found but no table/list below it; marker_missing = anchor not found in target note.
